title: Implement iOS Lock Down Profile for iOS iPhones in Microsoft Intune for Shared Devices
author_notes: Shaping note: the solution must cover how to USE, PROVISION, and LOG IN to BOTH a Shared device AND a Corporate device managed by Microsoft Intune.

Effort tier: T3 (lock-down configuration/restrictions profile for shared iPhones + dual provisioning models — shared no-user-affinity vs corporate user-affinity — plus enrollment, compliance, and end-user login/use flows).

Distinct from ios-iphone-shared-device-mode (IOSSDM = kiosk locked specifically to Cisco Webex). This product centers on the lock-down PROFILE itself and the dual shared-vs-corporate provisioning + login experience; do not duplicate the Webex-kiosk product. version_directive: New; branding: off (white-label).
